CF_ACCOUNT_ID.label: Cloudflare account ID
CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: The account child projects are provisioned onto.

PLATFORM_ZONE.label: Platform zone
PLATFORM_ZONE.description: Zone assigned project subdomains live under, e.g. premium-cms.com

DEPLOY_SERVICE_URL.label: Deploy service URL
DEPLOY_SERVICE_URL.description: The PremiumCMS marketplace worker that uploads golden bundles (default https://marketplace.premium-cms.com).

DEPLOY_KEY.label: Deploy key
DEPLOY_KEY.description: Shared secret accepted by the deploy service.

PAYMENT_PROVIDER.label: Payment provider
PAYMENT_PROVIDER.description: How projects buy credits. Pick a provider, then add its keys below and register the webhook URL with the provider.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.label: Stripe webhook signing secret
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: whsec_… from the webhook endpoint you create at dashboard.stripe.com/webhooks for the URL below (event: checkout.session.completed).

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_URL.label: Stripe webhook URL
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Add this endpoint in Stripe → Developers → Webhooks, listening for checkout.session.completed.

POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Polar organization access token
POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: polar_oat_… with checkouts:write, checkouts:read and customers:write scopes.

POLAR_PRODUCT_ID.label: Polar product ID (credits)
POLAR_PRODUCT_ID.description: A one-time "pay what you want" product in your Polar organization; each purchase is a credit top-up for that amount.

POLAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET.label: Polar webhook secret
POLAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Secret of the webhook endpoint you create in Polar → Settings → Webhooks for the URL below (events: checkout.updated, order.created).

POLAR_WEBHOOK_URL.label: Polar webhook URL
POLAR_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Add this endpoint in Polar → Settings → Webhooks.

GITHUB_APP_ID.label: GitHub App ID
GITHUB_APP_ID.description: Projects INSTALL the app (Vercel-style); the platform mints short-lived installation tokens.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.label: GitHub OAuth app client ID (legacy fallback)

GITHUB_TEMPLATE_REPO.label: Frontend template repository
GITHUB_TEMPLATE_REPO.description: owner/name of the public template repo; empty = platform default.

DEFAULT_COLOR_SCHEME.label: Default color scheme
DEFAULT_COLOR_SCHEME.description: Marketplace color scheme applied to new projects (Admin → Color schemes); a theme may set its own when applied. Default modern-minimal.

CREDITS_MARKUP.label: Credits markup
CREDITS_MARKUP.description: Cost-plus multiplier applied to the provider's cost (default 2 = charge $2 per $1 of cost).

PRICE_LIST_JSON.label: Price list overrides (JSON)
PRICE_LIST_JSON.description: Micro-dollar parent cost per unit, e.g. {"email:send":120}. Keys: grant:read, grant:write, grant:heavy, media:upload, media:mb, email:send, plugin:route, cf:request, cf:cpu_ms, cf:d1_rows_read, cf:d1_rows_written, cf:r2_class_a, cf:r2_class_b, cf:r2_gb_day.

CREDITS_ENFORCE.label: Enforce credits ("true"/"false")
CREDITS_ENFORCE.description: When true, projects with a zero balance cannot perform write actions until they buy credits. Pushed to projects at setup and on "Push credit settings".

BACKUP_STORE_URL.label: Backup store (master instance URL)
BACKUP_STORE_URL.description: Instance that owns the platform-artifacts bucket; D1 exports are copied there. Default https://master.premium-cms.com

BACKUP_STORE_SECRET.label: Backup store secret
BACKUP_STORE_SECRET.description: The master instance's PROVISION_SECRET (sent as x-provision-secret).

BACKUPS_ENABLED.label: Nightly backups
BACKUPS_ENABLED.description: Export every live project's database to the backup store each night (03:10 UTC).

grants.label: Manage projects
grants.description: Create, deploy, set up, destroy projects and their domains
